# liblsl

Bundled official liblsl 1.17.7 macOS universal framework (Apple Silicon and Intel).
Source: https://github.com/sccn/liblsl
Release asset: https://github.com/sccn/liblsl/releases/download/v1.17.7/lsl.xcframework.1.17.zip
Archive SHA-256: 7886450aa2abe8545417f2c7eb11a9e1b224c9e33d716cfccb13a01706d5b593
Only lsl.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/lsl.framework is included.
No installer or system-wide library installation is required.
